senses.definition: to look at something or someone quickly

examples.text: She glanced at her watch and stood up.
examples.translation: O, saatına nəzər salıb ayağa qalxdı.

examples.text: He glanced around the room, looking for his friend.
examples.translation: O, dostunu axtararaq otağa ötəri göz gəzdirdi.

senses.definition: a quick look

examples.text: I knew at a glance that something was wrong.
examples.translation: Bir baxışdan nəyinsə qaydasında olmadığını başa düşdüm.

examples.text: She gave me a quick glance and smiled.

senses.definition: very small

examples.text: They live in a tiny apartment in the city center.
examples.translation: Onlar şəhər mərkəzində kiçicik bir mənzildə yaşayırlar.

examples.text: There was a tiny spider on the wall.
examples.translation: Divarda xırda bir hörümçək var idi.

senses.definition: a separate small space inside something, such as a bag, a box or a train

examples.text: My bag has a secret compartment for my passport.
examples.translation: Çantamda pasportum üçün gizli bir gözcük var.

examples.text: We found an empty compartment on the train.

senses.definition: to turn something with your hand, or to bend something so that it changes shape

examples.text: Twist the cap to open the bottle.
She twisted her ankle on the stairs.

senses.definition: to make a long, high sound, like an old door or floor when it moves

examples.text: The old wooden stairs creaked under my feet.
examples.translation: Köhnə taxta pilləkən ayağımın altında cırıldayırdı.

examples.text: The door creaks every time you open it.

senses.definition: a long, high sound made by something old when it moves

examples.text: We heard a creak from the kitchen.
With a loud creak, the gate opened.

senses.definition: to put a sign, a line or a color on something to show something

examples.text: I marked the important words in yellow.
Mark the meeting in your calendar.

senses.definition: a spot or a line on a surface; also a grade for school work

examples.text: There's a coffee mark on your shirt.
She got top marks in her English exam.
examples.translation: O, ingilis dili imtahanından ən yüksək qiyməti aldı.

senses.definition: a person who sees something happen, or who is present when something is done

examples.text: The police are looking for witnesses to the accident.
You need two witnesses to sign the document.
examples.translation: Sənədi imzalamaq üçün iki şahid lazımdır.

senses.definition: to see something happen

examples.text: Did anyone witness the accident?
We witnessed a beautiful sunrise from the mountain.
examples.translation: Dağdan gözəl gün doğuşunun şahidi olduq.

senses.definition: to move closer to someone or something

examples.text: A young man approached me and asked for directions.
examples.translation: Bir gənc mənə yaxınlaşıb yol soruşdu.

examples.text: Winter is approaching, so the days are getting shorter.
examples.translation: Qış yaxınlaşır, ona görə günlər qısalır.

senses.definition: to let someone do something

examples.text: My parents didn't allow me to go to the party.
Dogs are not allowed in this park.

senses.definition: to look at something or someone carefully to learn about it or to find a problem

examples.text: The doctor examined my throat.
We examined the old map closely.

senses.definition: not firmly fixed in place; also not tight on your body

examples.text: One of my teeth is loose.
These trousers are too loose for me.

senses.definition: a round shape, like the letter O

examples.text: The children sat in a circle on the floor.
Draw a circle around the right answer.

senses.definition: to draw a circle around something, or to move around something in a circle

examples.text: Circle the words you don't know.
A plane circled above the airport.
examples.translation: Bir təyyarə hava limanının üzərində dövrə vururdu.

senses.definition: with nothing or nobody inside

examples.text: The fridge is almost empty.
The streets were empty early in the morning.

senses.definition: to take everything out of something

examples.text: Can you empty the trash, please?
examples.translation: Zəhmət olmasa, zibil qabını boşalda bilərsən?

examples.text: She emptied her bag onto the table.

senses.definition: to bring your eyebrows together because you are angry, worried or thinking hard

examples.text: Why are you frowning? Is something wrong?
He frowned at the long list of tasks.
examples.translation: O, uzun tapşırıq siyahısına baxıb qaşlarını çatdı.

senses.definition: the look on your face when you bring your eyebrows together

examples.text: She looked at the bill with a frown.
His frown disappeared when he heard the good news.
examples.translation: Yaxşı xəbəri eşidəndə onun qaşqabağı açıldı.

senses.definition: to be discovered to be true, or to happen in a particular way in the end

examples.text: It turns out that we went to the same school.
examples.translation: Məlum olur ki, biz eyni məktəbdə oxumuşuq.

examples.text: Don't worry, everything will turn out fine.
examples.translation: Narahat olma, hər şey yaxşı olacaq.

sentences.text: Early on Sunday morning, before the neighbors woke up, Sevda went down to the lobby to examine the old clock.
sentences.translation: Bazar günü səhər tezdən, qonşular oyanmamış, Sevda köhnə saatı diqqətlə yoxlamaq üçün vestibülə endi.

sentences.text: It was a tall wooden clock with a glass door, and its hands still showed a quarter past seven.
sentences.translation: Bu, şüşə qapılı hündür taxta saat idi və əqrəbləri hələ də yeddini on beş dəqiqə keçəni göstərirdi.

sentences.text: The little door creaked when she opened it.
Inside, she noticed a tiny brass handle that was a little loose.
sentences.translation: İçəridə bir az laxlamış kiçicik mis bir dəstəyin fərqinə vardı.

sentences.text: She twisted it carefully, and a small hidden compartment opened.
sentences.translation: O, dəstəyi ehtiyatla burdu və kiçik gizli bir gözcük açıldı.

sentences.text: Inside, there was an old map of the basement, and room 3 was marked with a red circle.
sentences.translation: İçində zirzəminin köhnə bir planı var idi və 3 nömrəli otaq qırmızı dairə ilə işarələnmişdi.

sentences.text: Next to it, someone had written: “7:15 is the time I closed my workshop for the last time. B.”
sentences.translation: Yanında kimsə yazmışdı: “7:15 – emalatxanamı sonuncu dəfə bağladığım vaxtdır. B.”

sentences.text: Sevda glanced at the clock again and felt a shiver.
sentences.translation: Sevda yenidən saata nəzər saldı və bədənindən üşütmə keçdi.

sentences.text: Suddenly, she heard footsteps behind her.
Mr. Tofig, the building manager, was approaching with a cup of coffee and a big frown.
sentences.translation: Bina müdiri Tofiq bəy əlində bir fincan qəhvə ilə, qaşqabaqlı halda ona yaxınlaşırdı.

sentences.text: “What are you doing with that clock?” he asked. “It hasn't been touched for twenty years!”
sentences.translation: “O saatla nə edirsən?” – deyə soruşdu. “İyirmi ildir ona heç kim toxunmayıb!”

sentences.text: Sevda explained everything and showed him the map.
sentences.translation: Sevda hər şeyi izah etdi və ona planı göstərdi.

sentences.text: Slowly, his frown turned into a smile.
“Well, this is strange,” he said. “Mr. Bahram called me last week. He asked if room 3 had been opened.”
sentences.translation: “Bu, qəribədir,” – dedi. “Bəhram müəllim keçən həftə mənə zəng etdi. 3 nömrəli otağın açılıb-açılmadığını soruşdu.”

sentences.text: “It turns out that he still pays for that room every year!”
sentences.translation: “Məlum olur ki, o, hələ də hər il o otaq üçün pul ödəyir!”

sentences.text: “So, can I go in?” Sevda asked.
sentences.translation: “Yəni içəri girə bilərəm?” – deyə Sevda soruşdu.

sentences.text: “I'll allow it,” Mr. Tofig said, “but the door will be opened tomorrow evening, and you must bring a witness.”
sentences.translation: “İcazə verirəm,” – dedi Tofiq bəy, – “amma qapı sabah axşam açılacaq və sən özünlə bir şahid gətirməlisən.”

grammar.topic: Passive voice: present perfect and future
grammar.topicTranslation: Məchul növ: present perfect və gələcək zaman
grammar.explanation: We use the passive when the action is more important than the person who does it, or when we don't know who does it. Present perfect passive: has/have + been + past participle (The clock hasn't been touched for years). Future passive: will + be + past participle (The door will be opened tomorrow). If we want to say who does the action, we add by + the person.
grammar.explanationTranslation: Məchul növ hərəkəti kimin etdiyindən daha vacib olanda və ya hərəkəti kimin etdiyini bilmədikdə işlədilir. Present perfect məchul: has/have + been + past participle (The clock hasn't been touched for years). Gələcək zaman məchul: will + be + past participle (The door will be opened tomorrow). Hərəkəti kimin etdiyini demək istəsək, by + şəxs əlavə edirik.

rules.text: Present perfect passive: has/have been + past participle: The room has been cleaned.
rules.translation: Present perfect məchul: has/have been + past participle: The room has been cleaned.

rules.text: Negative and question: It hasn't been opened. / Has it been opened?
rules.translation: İnkar və sual: It hasn't been opened. / Has it been opened?

rules.text: Future passive: will be + past participle: The results will be announced on Monday.
rules.translation: Gələcək zaman məchul: will be + past participle: The results will be announced on Monday.

rules.text: Add by + person only when it is important: The door will be opened by Mr. Tofig.
rules.translation: By + şəxs yalnız vacib olanda əlavə edilir: The door will be opened by Mr. Tofig.

rules.text: Don't forget been: The letter has been sent (not The letter has sent).
rules.translation: Been sözünü unutmayın: The letter has been sent (The letter has sent yox).

examples.text: The clock hasn't been touched for twenty years.
Room 3 has been marked with a red circle.
examples.translation: 3 nömrəli otaq qırmızı dairə ilə işarələnib.

examples.text: The door will be opened tomorrow evening.
Has the envelope been delivered yet?
A witness will be needed.

exercise.instructions: Choose or write the correct passive form.
exercise.instructionsTranslation: Düzgün məchul formanı seçin və ya yazın.

questions.prompt: The windows ___ yet. They're still dirty.
questions.promptTranslation: Pəncərələr hələ silinməyib. Hələ də çirklidirlər.
questions.explanation: The windows don't clean themselves, so we use the passive: haven't been + past participle.
questions.explanationTranslation: Pəncərələr özləri silmir, ona görə məchul növ işlədilir: haven't been + past participle.

questions.explanation: Future passive: will be + past participle.
questions.explanationTranslation: Gələcək zamanın məchul forması: will be + past participle.

questions.explanation: Present perfect passive question: Has + subject + been + past participle?
questions.explanationTranslation: Present perfect məchul sual: Has + mübtəda + been + past participle?

questions.explanation: Next year = future, so we use will be + past participle.
questions.explanationTranslation: Gələn il gələcək zamandır, ona görə will be + past participle işlədilir.

questions.prompt: My bike ___ (steal)! I can't find it anywhere.
questions.promptTranslation: Velosipedimi oğurlayıblar! Onu heç yerdə tapa bilmirəm.
questions.explanation: We don't know who did it, and the result is now: has been + past participle.
questions.explanationTranslation: Kimin etdiyini bilmirik və nəticə indi görünür: has been + past participle.
